blocks.text: PRAXAGORA. BLEPYRUS, husband of Praxagora. WOMEN. A MAN. CHREMES. TWO CITIZENS. HERALD. AN OLD MAN. A GIRL. A YOUNG MAN. THREE OLD WOMEN. A SERVANT MAID. HER MASTER. CHORUS OF WOMEN.
SCENE: Before a house in a Public Square at Athens; a lamp is burning over the door. Time: a little after midnight.
